rules.statement: When a sale is conducted by an auctioneer acting on orders of the Court and subject to conditions approved by the Court, the question that arises in setting aside the sale or refusing to confirm it is whether the Judge is exercising his discretion properly and judicially.
rules.supporting_quote: I do not think he is limited to the grounds upon which sales held by the Fiscal are set aside. In this instance in the view taken by the Judge of what actually happened on the occasion of this sale, it is impossible for us to say that he has exercised his discretion in a wrong or improper manner and, therefore, we ought not to interfere with his order.

meta.parties: Cader Et Al v. Mohamed Et Al
